entities.summary: Dynamo Palace of Sports in Krylatskoye is a multi-purpose indoor sporting arena in Krylatskoye District, Moscow, Russia. The arena has mainly been used to host futsal, boxing, and basketball. The seating capacity of the arena is for 5,000 people.
